set.body: FOLLOW-UP from independent source review of e04d8b62: existing complete-base-cost court verifies delegation/equality with the already checked HSMM codec, but does not independently witness populated reduction/imputation/exclusion values. Add one synthetic populated reduction/support/imputation fixture plus an excluded bookkeeping cell, assert concrete serialized retained values, and assert excluded cells stay in baseCosts while omitted from local-comparison states. This is test-strength work, not a blocker on the codec reuse already confirmed by source inspection. No corpus data or production numeric change. Existing source tests and full codec checks remain the control.
